text: 2026-08-03 evidence: S16 now compares production OLS against an independent reduced full-rank oracle for fitted values, residuals, projection action, rank, and an estimable function. This intentionally avoids asserting arbitrary coefficient equality under a rank-deficient parameterization. Remaining gap: FitResult does not yet expose a first-class alias/pivot report for the duplicate-column case; the structural hypothesis path rejects the duplicate component, but richer numerical alias diagnostics remain Phase 2 work.
